reading.name: Economic Regions
reading.definition: Count occupied settlements in this road-connected trade zone, including this one and neutral towns. Frontier and ruins break the zone. Each counts once; connecting two zones joins them. Scholar discipline. This card adds 1 per count, capped at 6. Base 1 + bonus 3 = 4 Stock before workers and Output Multiplier, then limited by capacity.

reading.name: Monster Trophies
reading.text: Monster Trophies 1 → +0. Dormant outside Warrior / Priest.
reading.definition: Count monsters actually destroyed by this civilisation, by Hunt or Campaign. Neutral conquests and successful defenses do not count. Trophies survive Vassal death; they are a count, not spendable Stock. Dormant outside Warrior / Priest. This card adds 1 per count, capped at 6. Base 1 + bonus 0 = 1 Research per Birth.
